name: Our Cinderella
source:
Iggy Maxwell is an anxious homebody who's never quite seen eye-to-eye with the concept of love. He just doesn't understand people. And people don't understand him. He should be content to plug away at his work and games in the safety of his little apartment for the rest of his days... right?

When one of his friends announces a Christmas party, though, things take a turn. Can he become Cinderella and find his prince at the party? Or is he doomed to spend the day bemoaning his fate in bed?

Play each day in the month of December leading up to the Christmas party. Have Iggy work, play games, or text his friends, all while managing his savings and social battery. If Iggy can purchase a complete party outfit and receive a sweet invitation from one of his friends before the day arrives, he'll be able to attend the party. But things can't just end there! 

Could heartbreak still await this sweats-to-suit Cinderella? Or might a happily ever after await him yet?

[From [url=https://carrotpatchgames.itch.io/our-cinderella]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伊吉·麦克斯韦是一个焦虑的宅男，她对爱的概念从来没有完全一致的看法。他就是不懂人。人们不理解他。他应该满足于在他的小公寓里安全地度过余生，埋头工作和游戏……对吧？

然而，当他的一位朋友宣布举办圣诞派对时，事情发生了转变。他能成为灰姑娘并在派对上找到他的王子吗？或者他注定要整天躺在床上哀叹自己的命运？

12月份圣诞晚会前的每一天都可以玩。让Iggy工作、玩游戏或给朋友发短信，同时管理他的储蓄和社交电池。如果伊吉能够购买一套完整的派对服装，并在​​这一天到来之前收到一位朋友的甜蜜邀请，他就能参加派对。但事情还不能就此结束！

这位一身汗水的灰姑娘还会心碎吗？或者幸福的生活还在等待着他吗？

[来自[url=https://carrotpatchgames.itch.io/our-cinderella]itch.io[/url]]
